preconditions.description: The number of tree nodes n must be an odd integer between 3 and 100,000.
The number of search keys k must be an integer between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= key <= 10**9 for key in node_keys) and all(1 <= key <= 10**9 for key in search_keys)
preconditions.description: All node keys and search keys must be positive integers not exceeding 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly k real numbers, one for each search key.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(value, float) for value in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each output value must be a real number.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(value - expected) <= 10**-9 for value, expected in zip(stdout, expected_values))
postconditions.description: Each output value must differ from the expected value by no more than 10^-9.
